'''Calfa-5''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CE" /> located along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] [[Great Rim Route]] between the [[Dreena system/Legends|Dreena]] and [[K'Farri system/Legends|K'Farri systems]]<ref name="EA" /> in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It had [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Moon/Legends|moons]]<ref name="CE" /> that baked under the [[Star/Legends|sunlight]]. A jaunt to the sunbaked moons of Calfa-5 was not regarded as a difficult undertaking.<ref name="NJO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calfa-5 was first mentioned in the [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]].<ref name="NJO" /> In [[2008]],<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> an entry for Calfa-5 was added to the reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed that it was a planet.<ref name="CE" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Calfa system/Legends|Calfa star system]] and the planet itself in grid square 0-9.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
